name: the moved rows keep their cached text
why: Removes the per-row _rowTextCache reset from _maybeCorrectAreaFlagRegion(). runFilter() matches the MASTER rows through that cache, so even a filter typed fresh after the correction reads the Locality/Region text from before the move. Must fail on 'C: a fresh key finds all six rows' (6 expected, 3 rendered) — the one test no replayed row list can explain.

name: a correction schedules no filter refresh at all
why: Removes the _scheduleAreaFlagFilterRefresh() call. Both halves go: the result cache keeps the pre-move row list, and an active filter is never re-run. Must fail on 'B: the retyped needle finds all six rows, not the cached three'.

name: the refresh no longer drops the filter-result cache
why: Leaves the scheduled re-run in place but removes _invalidateFilterCache() from it, so runFilter() is served the row list cached under the needle's own key. Must fail on the same B assertion — the drop, not just the re-run, is load-bearing.

name: an active filter is not re-run after a correction
why: Keeps the cache drop but never re-runs the filter, so the table goes on showing rows by a Locality value the correction has taken away from them. Must fail on 'D: the corrected rows drop out of a Locality filter they no longer match' (0 expected, 3 still rendered).

name: the text reset writes null into cols[] (the a861512 sentinel trap)
why: cols is 'not cached' at undefined; null is a VALUE, so _cachedColText() returns it and testRowMatch() throws on .toLowerCase() mid-runFilter(). Must fail — on the isolation test and/or its uncaught-page-error afterEach, whichever trips first.

name: the per-frame coalescing guard is dropped
why: Without it every corrected row schedules its own refresh, so a sweep re-renders the table once per corrected row instead of once. That is a cost, not a wrong answer, and these fixtures correct only three rows — no assertion can see it. KNOWN UNCOVERED: catching it needs a render counter or a page big enough for the cost to show.
